title: Camp Wabanna

services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: Wabanna Camp and Retreat Center operates a 7 week summer Residential Camp for boys and girls ages 7-15 and an 8 week Summer Day Camp for boys and girls ages 5-13. Camps run from mid-June to mid-August. Through the employment of a well-trained and highly motivated staff, we strive to provide an environment in which children and teenagers can benefit from both personal relationships and one-on-one discipleship and interaction. In addition to daily Bible studies, chapel services, and devotional time, Wabanna offers an intense, action-packed schedule filled with a wide variety of team building activities and events such as group games, low and high element challenge courses, boating and tubing,

blurb: Established in 1941, Wabanna Camp and Retreat Center is a non-profit, non-denominational Christian ministry located in Edgewater, Maryland, on a 23-acre point where the Rhode and West Rivers converge into the Chesapeake Bay.
